phrases.fr: L'écart peut s'expliquer par des différences de méthodologie.
Tout bien considéré, les éléments disponibles favorisent un essai limité.
Ce n'est qu'après avoir comparé les rapports que nous avons compris la différence.
La conclusion reste provisoire à la lumière de ces limites.

questions.prompt: Which connector introduces an opposite relationship?
questions.explanation: Conversely annonce une relation inverse.

questions.passage: Report A recommends a six-week trial because the team needs rapid feedback. Report B also supports a trial but proposes twelve weeks so that seasonal differences can be observed. Neither report recommends immediate permanent adoption. The disagreement concerns duration, rather than whether testing is needed.
questions.prompt: Which synthesis preserves both agreement and disagreement?
choices: Both favour testing, but differ on the time needed.
One supports testing and the other rejects it.
Both propose exactly the same schedule.
questions.explanation: La réponse doit être justifiée par les informations du texte.

questions.prompt: ___ the limited sample, the conclusion should remain provisional.
questions.explanation: In light of signifie à la lumière de et précède un groupe nominal.

questions.prompt: The two measures are correlated; this does not necessarily establish ___.
questions.explanation: Une corrélation ne prouve pas un lien de cause à effet.

questions.passage: Two studies found higher attendance after a new timetable was introduced. In the first, transport was unchanged. In the second, additional buses began operating at the same time. A reviewer argues that the studies cannot establish the timetable's effect with equal confidence.
questions.prompt: Why does the reviewer distinguish the studies?
choices: The second includes another change that could influence attendance.
The second contains no attendance data.
The first also introduced additional buses.
Both isolate the timetable's effect equally well.
questions.explanation: La réponse doit être justifiée par les informations du texte.

questions.prompt: Which sentence accurately limits a conclusion?
choices: The result applies to the participants studied.
The result applies to everyone everywhere.
The result establishes a universal law.
The result proves all alternatives false.
questions.explanation: La portée est limitée aux participants effectivement étudiés.

questions.prompt: Only after the methods were compared ___ the discrepancy.
questions.explanation: Only after en tête entraîne l'inversion dans la proposition principale.

questions.passage: An evaluation reports that participants found the tool helpful, but some withdrew before completing the survey. The author notes that the responses may therefore underrepresent dissatisfied users and describes the positive findings as provisional.
questions.prompt: What does the limitation concern?
choices: Whether the respondents represent all participants.
Whether any participants used the tool.
Whether the survey contained a title.
questions.explanation: La réponse doit être justifiée par les informations du texte.

questions.prompt: The account is useful ___ it explains the observed differences.
questions.explanation: Insofar as indique dans quelle mesure l'affirmation s'applique.

questions.prompt: Choose a synthesis rather than a list.
choices: Both reports favour a trial, but differ over its duration.
Report A has five pages. Report B has seven pages.
Report A has a cover. Report B has a contents page.
There are two reports on the table.
questions.explanation: La synthèse met en relation les positions des deux textes.

questions.passage: An editor asks a writer to combine three accounts into one briefing. The writer removes repeated details, retains conflicting explanations and identifies which claims are independently supported. The briefing avoids suggesting that agreement exists where the accounts differ.
questions.prompt: Which feature best demonstrates effective synthesis?
choices: Integrating information while preserving meaningful disagreements.
Copying the accounts in their original order.
Treating repeated claims as automatically proven.
questions.explanation: La réponse doit être justifiée par les informations du texte.

questions.prompt: Which phrase signals an overall judgement after weighing factors?
questions.explanation: On balance annonce un jugement tenant compte de plusieurs facteurs.

objectives: Fine distinctions, pragmatic implication, idiomatic restraint

phrases.fr: La réponse était délibérément prudente plutôt que simplement vague.
Avec le recul, l'avertissement méritait davantage d'attention.
L'auteur concède la limite sans abandonner l'argument central.
À première vue, les récits semblent cohérents.

questions.prompt: Which phrase indicates reluctant rather than enthusiastic approval?
questions.explanation: Grudging signale une acceptation réticente.

questions.passage: After a lengthy discussion, the reviewer writes: I can live with the revised wording, provided we retain the qualification in the final sentence. The reviewer had previously objected to the broader claim. No additional evidence has been submitted, and the revision narrows the claim rather than strengthening its support.
questions.prompt: Which interpretation is most defensible?
choices: Conditional, reluctant acceptance of a narrower claim.
Enthusiastic endorsement of the original broad claim.
Confirmation that new evidence proves the original claim.
An unconditional instruction to remove the qualification.
questions.explanation: La réponse doit être justifiée par les informations du texte.

questions.prompt: Which word describes a mistake made without intention?
questions.explanation: Inadvertent signifie involontaire.

questions.prompt: Choose the most precise description of an unclear response.
questions.explanation: Equivocal décrit une réponse qui admet plusieurs interprétations.

questions.passage: The spokesperson says that the team did not intend to mislead readers, while acknowledging that the summary omitted an important limitation. A critic responds that intention and effect should not be conflated. The critic does not claim to know what individual team members believed.
questions.prompt: What distinction is the critic drawing?
choices: An omission can mislead regardless of whether deception was intended.
An absence of intent guarantees accurate interpretation.
The summary contained all relevant qualifications.
questions.explanation: La réponse doit être justifiée par les informations du texte.

questions.prompt: The author concedes that the trial was limited. What does concedes imply here?
choices: Acknowledges a point that weakens the argument.
Withdraws every claim in the article.
questions.explanation: Concede peut marquer la reconnaissance d'un point défavorable.

questions.prompt: Which sentence explicitly separates appearance from established fact?
choices: On the face of it, the explanation seems plausible.
The explanation leaves no room for doubt.
questions.explanation: On the face of it limite le jugement à l'apparence initiale.

questions.passage: In a retrospective account, the writer describes the decision as understandable at the time but difficult to defend with hindsight. The information that later exposed its weaknesses was unavailable when the decision was made. The writer therefore resists calling the original decision either plainly irrational or ultimately sound.
questions.prompt: Which paraphrase preserves the nuance?
choices: The decision had a contemporary rationale but looks weaker in light of later knowledge.
The decision was irrational according to information everyone already had.
Later evidence conclusively vindicated the decision.
The writer refuses to assess the decision in any way.
questions.explanation: La réponse doit être justifiée par les informations du texte.

questions.prompt: Which phrase introduces a judgement made using knowledge gained later?
questions.explanation: With hindsight signifie avec le recul.

questions.prompt: For all that the report is detailed, its central claim remains unsupported. Choose the closest meaning.
choices: Although detailed, the report does not substantiate its main claim.
Because detailed, the report proves its main claim.
The report is neither detailed nor relevant.
The report's detail makes evidence unnecessary.
questions.explanation: For all that introduit ici une concession.

questions.passage: An observer characterises the board's silence as tacit approval. The minutes, however, record that the board postponed discussion pending legal advice. A second observer cautions that silence under those circumstances need not imply endorsement. No vote was taken, and no member stated an opinion.
questions.prompt: Which conclusion is warranted?
choices: The available record does not establish approval.
The absence of a vote makes the first observer's claim certain.
questions.explanation: La réponse doit être justifiée par les informations du texte.

questions.prompt: Which action would overstate the evidence?
choices: Calling a tentative association a proven cause.
questions.explanation: Overstate signifie présenter une portée ou une force excessive.

phrases.fr: Le résumé conserve l'affirmation originale et sa réserve.
Des documents indépendants corroborent le récit.
Si le contexte avait été conservé, la citation aurait été moins trompeuse.
La réfutation porte sur les éléments de preuve plutôt que sur l'orateur.

questions.prompt: Which reformulation preserves a necessary caveat?
choices: The estimate is useful, provided its uncertainty is acknowledged.
The estimate is useful and entirely certain.
The estimate is useless because all estimates are uncertain.
The estimate proves the outcome will occur.
questions.explanation: Provided conserve la condition attachée au jugement.

questions.passage: Account A says that the pilot reduced delays at two sites, although staffing also increased. Account B reports no measurable change at a third site where staffing stayed constant. Account C recommends collecting comparable staffing and delay data before extending the pilot. A summary claims that all three accounts prove the pilot itself reduced delays everywhere.
questions.prompt: Which revision most faithfully reconstructs the evidence?
choices: Results vary across sites, and staffing differences prevent a simple causal conclusion.
All sites showed the same improvement caused solely by the pilot.
The pilot failed at every site and should immediately end.
The staffing information is irrelevant because three accounts exist.
questions.explanation: La réponse doit être justifiée par les informations du texte.

questions.prompt: Which sentence presupposes that an error has occurred?
choices: When did you correct the error?
Could there have been an error?
Is the result free from errors?
questions.explanation: When did you correct... suppose déjà l'existence d'une erreur corrigée.

questions.prompt: Which is an understatement of a serious failure?
choices: The system had a few difficulties, after a complete collapse.
questions.explanation: A few difficulties atténue fortement un effondrement total.

questions.passage: An editorial calls a decision brave, then notes that those making it would bear none of the financial risk and had ignored repeated warnings. The positive adjective sits beside details that undermine its ordinary approving sense. The editorial provides no direct statement that the decision was wise.
questions.prompt: What reading best fits the rhetorical context?
choices: Brave is likely used ironically to criticise the decision.
The editorial avoids any evaluation of the decision.
The financial risk is offered as evidence of personal sacrifice.
questions.explanation: La réponse doit être justifiée par les informations du texte.

questions.prompt: Which paraphrase faithfully preserves some rather than all?
questions.explanation: Several ne transforme pas une partie du groupe en totalité.

questions.prompt: The report was not without merit. Choose the closest meaning.
questions.explanation: Not without merit reconnaît un mérite sans affirmer la perfection.

questions.passage: The original report states that the intervention may benefit some participants under closely supervised conditions. A promotional summary states that the intervention benefits participants. The summary omits both the uncertainty marker and the conditions, while retaining the favourable core of the statement.
questions.prompt: How has the meaning changed?
choices: A qualified possibility has become a broader assertion.
A universal certainty has become a cautious possibility.
The conditions have been made more explicit.
The summary preserves every limitation accurately.
questions.explanation: La réponse doit être justifiée par les informations du texte.

questions.prompt: Which response addresses the claim rather than attacking its author?
choices: The conclusion overlooks the smaller comparison group.
The author is an unpleasant person.
The author has a boring speaking style.
questions.explanation: La critique porte sur le raisonnement et ses données.

questions.prompt: Had the qualification been retained, the summary ___ more faithful.
questions.explanation: Une hypothèse passée utilise would have + participe.

questions.passage: Two documents make identical claims and use the same wording. Later inspection shows that both copied a single unverified memorandum. A third document independently records events that support only part of the claim. A careful reconstruction separates the copied assertion from the independently supported portion.
questions.prompt: Which principle should guide the synthesis?
choices: Distinguish independent corroboration from duplicated assertions.
Count every copy as a separate confirming source.
Present the entire claim as verified because it appears twice.
questions.explanation: La réponse doit être justifiée par les informations du texte.

questions.prompt: Which sentence distinguishes corroboration from repetition?
choices: Two independent records support the account.
Two copies repeat the same unsupported statement.
A claim appears in a larger font.
questions.explanation: La corroboration apporte un appui indépendant.
